explanation: Main Airbus short- and medium-haul jet families commonly used on dense European scheduled passenger routes.
Boeing narrowbody short- and medium-haul family, dominated here by the 737 series and especially relevant for European low-cost and scheduled traffic.
Large long-haul or heavy aircraft families, including both Airbus and Boeing widebody platforms; this group may also capture some freight-capable heavy aircraft.
Smaller regional jet families typically used on feeder, lower-demand, or thinner intra-European routes.
Business and corporate aviation families, usually associated with private, executive, charter, or special-purpose flights rather than regular mass passenger traffic.
